# Warlock AI

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai`

> Core @warlock.js AI framework — contracts, agent, workflow, supervisor

## Skills

- [ai-basics](@warlock.js/ai/ai-basics/SKILL.md): Start here for @warlock.js/ai application setup, provider configuration, and its core agent primitives.
- [ai-dx-helpers](@warlock.js/ai/ai-dx-helpers/SKILL.md): Configure @warlock.js/ai developer-experience helpers for batching, fallback, evaluation, SLOs, and supervisor middleware.
- [approve-tool-calls](@warlock.js/ai/approve-tool-calls/SKILL.md): Approve tool calls — the human-in-the-loop gate in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to approve tool calls.
- [attach-ai-middleware](@warlock.js/ai/attach-ai-middleware/SKILL.md): Middleware — agent-level pipeline in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to attach ai middleware.
- [define-ai-tool](@warlock.js/ai/define-ai-tool/SKILL.md): ai.tool() — typed tool factory in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to define ai tool.
- [detect-and-redact-pii](@warlock.js/ai/detect-and-redact-pii/SKILL.md): Detect and redact PII (and moderate) in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to detect and redact pii.
- [durable-agent-runs](@warlock.js/ai/durable-agent-runs/SKILL.md): Durable agent + planner runs — resume from the last checkpoint in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to durable agent runs.
- [durable-resume](@warlock.js/ai/durable-resume/SKILL.md): Durable resume — persist the interrupt, approve from another process in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to durable resume.
- [embed-text](@warlock.js/ai/embed-text/SKILL.md): Embeddings — peer primitive on the SDK adapter in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to embed text.
- [escalate-block-to-human](@warlock.js/ai/escalate-block-to-human/SKILL.md): Escalate a block to a human in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to escalate block to human.
- [eval-datasets-and-ci](@warlock.js/ai/eval-datasets-and-ci/SKILL.md): ai.dataset() + agent.eval() regression CI in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to eval datasets and ci.
- [generate-images](@warlock.js/ai/generate-images/SKILL.md): Generate images — the image-output verb (ai.image) in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to generate images.
- [generate-speech](@warlock.js/ai/generate-speech/SKILL.md): Generate speech — the text-to-speech verb (ai.speech) in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to generate speech.
- [guard-input-output](@warlock.js/ai/guard-input-output/SKILL.md): Guard agent input, output, and tool args in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to guard input output.
- [handle-ai-errors](@warlock.js/ai/handle-ai-errors/SKILL.md): Typed errors — AIError hierarchy in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to handle ai errors.
- [log-ai-calls](@warlock.js/ai/log-ai-calls/SKILL.md): Logging — log from @warlock.js/logger in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to log ai calls.
- [manage-ai-stores](@warlock.js/ai/manage-ai-stores/SKILL.md): Orchestrator stores — checkpoint vs snapshot in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to manage ai stores.
- [manage-prompts](@warlock.js/ai/manage-prompts/SKILL.md): ai.prompts — the unified prompt registry in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to manage prompts.
- [observe-ai-flows](@warlock.js/ai/observe-ai-flows/SKILL.md): The Observer seam — generic, tool-agnostic observability in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to observe ai flows.
- [persist-ai-data](@warlock.js/ai/persist-ai-data/SKILL.md): Persistence — @warlock.js/cache everywhere in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to persist ai data.

- [run-supervisor](@warlock.js/ai/run-supervisor/SKILL.md): ai.supervisor() — multi-intent routing in @warlock.js/ai; use when you need to run supervisor.
